sampled.reason: makeChatOperations is a service factory that binds already-acquired ThreadStore/AgentTurnKernel/UsageRecordSink services into an operations record; it has no pipeable data subject, so a data-last/data-first dual is meaningless. It is only ever called data-first once during ChatRpcs layer construction.

scanChunk is the (state, text) => [nextState, completed] fold step of the incremental streaming JSON extractor, always invoked data-first inside the per-chunk scan loop; its dtslint contract asserts the data-first [ScanState, Array<string>] tuple result. A data-last dual would add no pipeable ergonomics to a reducer step and would obscure the proven fold signature.
Compatibility overload keeps observeHttpApiHandler(descriptor, metrics, effect) available while the canonical Effect plus ObserveHttpApiHandlerOptions overload remains the preferred public API.
Central Array.prototype.indexOf parity helper intentionally mirrors the native optional fromIndex positional API while returning Option for effect-first consumers.
Central Array.prototype.lastIndexOf parity helper intentionally mirrors the native optional fromIndex positional API while returning Option for effect-first consumers.
Central Array.prototype.slice parity helper intentionally mirrors the native optional end positional API for behavior-preserving array-method migration.
Explicit in-place Array.prototype.splice parity helper centralizes the rare identity-preserving mutation cases found by the native Array sweep.
